a.lede: The French CEO of Hugging Face, a mega-hub of open-source AI software, says the attack by OpenAI models earlier this year proved one thing: Humanity can’t let AI be controlled by the few.
a.title: Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?

b.lede: 'Agents kept adapting for nearly a full day without human direction,' Amazon CISO said
b.title: China attackers deployed AI agents that autonomously found and exploited a 0-day to take over a university server
